name: Longevity Weekly
tagline: The science of aging, read carefully.
description: Longevity Weekly is an education and awareness show about the science of aging. Every Wednesday: the week's most useful research — exercise, sleep, diet, the biology and the tests — and one mechanism of aging explained properly — what it is, what the evidence shows in animals and in people, and what it does not show. Education only; never medical advice.
